args.lesson: For area-min CORDIC specs (>=1 MSPS, err <= 2^-10), iterative family with data_width=15, n_iter=12, angle_guard=1, rounding=round wins (est 251 luts+ffs, measured 216 LUTs/107 FFs/150.7 MHz). Cost model underestimates LUTs by ~19% and FFs by ~11% vs yosys+nextpnr-xilinx; Fmax underestimated by ~10%. Pipelined variants too area-hungry for this class.
